sentences.en: The thermometer stood at three degrees below zero this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上温度计显示的是零下三度。

sentences.en: I guess having zero shame is the price of genius.
sentences.zh: 我觉得没有羞耻感是天才的代价。

sentences.en: The temperature has been below zero for many days now.
sentences.zh: 气温已经连续好几天都在零度以下了。

senses.zh: 零，零度；零点，最低点；无，没有
